svg.aria-label: Miller indices and the {110} family of planes
svg.text: Miller indices and the {110} family of planes
Plane is parallel to the z-axis.
{110} = the family of all planes equivalent to (110) by symmetry
The six distinct planes of the {110} family
(each plane and its negative, e.g. (110) and (1̄1̄0), are the same set of parallel planes)
All {110} planes are diagonal planes of the cube; in BCC they are the close-packed planes.
